name: SoL-Pi
one_liner: Scales automated research loops that tune agent harnesses.

text.why: Agent setups are still mostly tuned by hand, one prompt and one tool at a time. SoL-Pi addresses running that tuning as an automated research loop and is published under the NVlabs account. It is written in TypeScript under the MIT license and has its own project page. The work is research-shaped, so it reads more like a method to borrow than a product to install.
text.take: Four efficiency mechanisms found by auto-research, packaged as a Pi extension; if you use Pi, try it.
build: An internal experiment loop that compares harness settings automatically
A review note porting the method into your current setup

who.situation: cuts tokens lost to repeated turns and re-read logs
studies the output of harness-efficiency experiments

start.text: Everything is off by default; enable it in ~/.pi/agent/sol-pi.json

caveat: An extension for Pi 0.84.2 and not an official Pi distribution
Everything is opt-in; without a config file nothing is enabled
The reducer may send logs to a remote model; read SECURITY.md first

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
